name: WorkflowTemplates
description: Represents a collection of WorkflowTemplate objects.
example:
Sub DisplayWorkTemplates()
Dim objWorkflowTemplates As WorkflowTemplates
Dim objWorkflowTemplate As WorkflowTemplate
Dim cnt As Integer

Set objWorkflowTemplates = Document.GetWorkflowTemplates()

For cnt = 1 To objWorkflowTemplates.Count
 Debug.Print objWorkflowTemplate(cnt).Name
Next

Set objWorkflowTemplate = objWorkflowTemplates(1)
objWorkflowTemplate.Show

End Sub

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the WorkflowTemplates object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the WorkflowTemplates object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Gets a WorkflowTemplate object from the WorkflowTemplates collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Gets a Long indicating the number of items in the WorkflowTemplates collection. Read-only.
